proposal_V_measurement.claim: 352fd35's enum closed the S4 truncation and, in the same change, made every repository's S4 unreproducible: normalize() writes a fact ID the enum forbids, so every stored S4 output is rejected on reuse.
proposal_V_measurement.mechanism: citable_fact_ids() builds the enum through bounded_records(), which honours core/facts.py::_EXCLUDED_FROM_PACKETS = {'identity:revision'}. rendering_fact_ids() reads facts.facts directly and returns identity:revision for the two deterministic sections whose RENDERING_FACT_KINDS include identity - 'identity' (8 IDs) and 'navigation' (5 IDs). normalize() folds a placement into such a section with entry['fact_ids'] = sorted(cited | set(rendering_fact_ids(destination, facts))). jobs.py::_parse validates the RAW reply against the enum (line 359) and only then runs checks (line 368), which is reconcile_checks -> normalize, mutating output in place; run_job stores the NORMALISED output. The live path accepts; the reuse path, which re-parses the stored normalised output, rejects.
proposal_V_measurement.replay_method: The stored batch-1 output loaded from the transaction's own call store and re-parsed through jobs._parse against three schemas, the last two mutated in memory only. Nothing written into the transaction, no tracked file edited, zero provider calls.

samples.note: This is what makes it a regression of 352fd35 rather than a pre-existing defect.

Batch 2 (Cells) and batches 2 and 3 (Slides), which place nothing into identity or navigation, reuse cleanly every time.

proposal_V_measurement.fix: citable_fact_ids() must admit every ID normalize() can itself write - union in rendering_fact_ids() over the deterministic sections (equivalently today, the _EXCLUDED_FROM_PACKETS members the renderer cites). This weakens nothing the enum was built for: the runaway 352fd35 cured was bare <kind>: prefixes naming no fact, and identity:revision is a real SUPPORTED fact the renderer reads directly.
alternatives_rejected: Reverting to the pattern - it re-opens the 32,000-token S4 truncation for the whole portfolio. The enum is right and is one value short.
Dropping identity:revision inside normalize - a supersession would then cite fewer facts than the section actually renders, which weakens BC-05's own subject.
proposal_V_measurement.mutation_test: A stored S4 output citing identity:revision must re-parse clean, and a bare <kind>: prefix must still be refused.
